name: Korean peninsula
summary: No North Korean missile launch found since 4 Nov; Kim says on 23 Nov the country will widen its foreign ties
state: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said North Korea fired multiple missiles, likely under 300 km range, toward the East Sea on 4 Nov; state media said it tested a new air defence system (Korea Herald). State media reported a new torpedo test on 10 Nov (Herald Business). On 23 Nov Kim Jong Un said the country would expand foreign relations and seeks neither supremacy nor expansion (AFP via Manila Times). No missile launch in the past two weeks, nuclear test or border clash was found to 25 Nov, so Normal holds.
for_you: No change for travellers; the FCDO advises against all travel to North Korea. South Korea and Japan run routine alert systems that warn residents if a launch threatens their territory.
rubric_hit: Normal: no missile launches in the past two weeks (last 4 Nov); no nuclear test or border incident

sources.title: Korea Herald — N. Korea says it test-fired new air defense missile system
Herald Business — North Korea tests new torpedo in Donghae

why: North Korea is a nuclear state with ICBMs; tension here involves the US, China, Japan and Russia simultaneously.
drivers: Missile tests, Russia–DPRK military cooperation, US–ROK exercises, border incidents.

rubric.alert: Nuclear test, ICBM overflight of Japan, or military clash.
rubric.watch: Ballistic or cruise missile launches, or troop deployments abroad.
rubric.normal: No missile launches in two weeks; no border incidents.
